finalText:
Build is clean now. The two real bugs were:

1. **`src/core/options.js`** — The new bundler passes `retryCount`, but the code was looking for the old `retries` property, causing it to fail.
2. **`src/net/retryPolicy.js`** — The new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but the code didn't handle that case and threw an error.

Both are fixed. The remaining 8 warnings are just deprecation noise from Node.js built-ins — not worth fixing. Exit code 0, everything ships clean.
